title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Late-Arrival Grace Minutes and Credits
content:
Northgate Delivery & Installation measures crew lateness against the end of the booked arrival window. Each service level sets the minutes after the end of the window before a crew arrival counts as late, the credit for a late arrival, and the charge on the appointment that the credit is applied to. The credit is never more than the charge it is applied to.

| Service level | Grace after the window ends | Late-arrival credit | Charge the credit is applied to |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | 30 minutes | $0.00 | Base delivery charge |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | 15 minutes | $20.00 | Base delivery charge |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | 15 minutes | $25.00 | Base delivery charge |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | 15 minutes | $50.00 | Base delivery charge |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | 15 minutes | $25.00 | Installation parts kit charge |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | 15 minutes | $25.00 | Wall-mount labor charge |

## Notes

- Northgate Curbside Delivery allows the longest grace, 30 minutes, and its credit is $0.00.
- At the two installation levels the credit is applied not to a base delivery charge but to the installation parts kit charge (Appliance Delivery & Installation) or the wall-mount labor charge (TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation).
- **Hypothetical cap.** A $25.00 credit applied to a charge of $20.00 comes to no more than $20.00.
